sloka: रामं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य शिरसा ऽभिप्रणम्य च ।रामेण चाभ्यनुज्ञातः शत्रुघ्नः शत्रुतापनः ।। ७.६४.१६ ॥
transliteration: rāmaṁ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śirasā 'bhipraṇamya ca ।rāmeṇa cābhyanujñātaḥ śatrughnaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ ।। 7.64.16 ॥

translations.english: Having circumambulated Rama and bowed down with his head, Shatrughna, the tormentor of enemies, was then given leave by Rama.
